---
title: "myTurbulenceModels"
author: "Jiří Fürst"
---

This package provides turbulence models for use in OpenFOAM simulations. It includes implementations of various RANS and LES models, along with utilities for model selection and parameter tuning.

## Installation

You can install the package from GitHub using the following command:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/furstj/myTurbulenceModels.git
cd myTurbulenceModels
./Allwmake
```

The `gammaSST` model is no more included directly in this repository as it is now part of [Turbulence Community Repository](https://gitlab.com/openfoam/community/tc-turbulence/turbulence-community). Nevertheless, it can be easily used in conjunction with this package either by installing the Turbulence Community module, or by clonning from my repository.

In the later case, you should clone the `gammaSST` model alongside the `myTurbulenceModels` package **before** running `Allwmake` in the `myTurbulenceModels` directory. The recommended way to clone and build the package with `gammaSST` support is as follows:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/furstj/gammaSST.git
git clone https://github.com/furstj/myTurbulenceModels.git
cd myTurbulenceModels
./Allwmake
```

## Features

### RANS Models

#### Turbulence Models

- [`kOmegaTNT`](RANS/kOmegaTNT.qmd) - Two-Equation k-ω Turbulence Model due to J. C. Kok
- [`kOmegaWilcox06`](RANS/kOmegaWilcox06.qmd) - Two-Equation k-ω Turbulence Model due to Wilcox
- [`kOmegaSSTCC`](RANS/kOmegaSSTCC.qmd) - Shear Stress Transport k-ω Model with Curvature Correction
- [`kOmegaSSTCCM`](RANS/kOmegaSSTCCM.qmd) - Shear Stress Transport k-ω Model with Curvature Correction
- [`EARSMko2005`](RANS/EARSM.qmd#sec-earsmko2005) - Explicit Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model due to Hellsten
- [`EARSMtnt`](RANS/EARSM.qmd#sec-earsmtnt) - Explicit Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model due to Wallin


#### Transition and Turbulence models
- [`kOmegaSSTLMRough`](Transition/kOmegaSSTLMRough.qmd) - Five-equation Transition and Turbulence Model with Roughness Modifications
- [`mykkLOmega`](Transition/mykkLOmega.qmd) - Three-equation transition and turbulence Model due to Walters and Cokljat
- [`EARSMlm2009`](RANS/EARSM.qmd#sec-earsmlm2009) - Explicit Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model with Transition due to Langtry and Menter
- [`gammaSST`](Transition/gammaSST.qmd) - Two-equation transition and turbulence Model due to Menter, Smirnov et al. Please note that this model is not included directly in this repository. See Installation


#### Experimental and development models
These models are not yet validated and require further testing and calibration. They are provided for research purposes and are not suitable for production use.

- [`kv2Omega`](Transition/kv2Omega.qmd) - Two-equation transition and turbulence Model due to Lopez and Walters
- [`EARSMgammaSST`](RANS/EARSM.qmd#sec-earsgammasst) - Explicit Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model with Transition and γ-SST 


#### Deprecated models

There are also some deprecated RANS turbulence models included in the package which have been replaced by newer implementations or are no more maintaned. These are:

- [`EARSMHellsten`](RANS/EARSMHellsten.qmd)  - Explicit Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model due to Hellsten (deprecated, use [`EARSMko2005`](RANS/EARSM.qmd#sec-earsmko2005) instead*)
- [`EARSMWallin`](RANS/EARSMWallin.qmd) - EARSM with Wallin's Modifications (*deprecated, use [`EARSMtnt`](RANS/EARSM.qmd#sec-earsmtnt) instead*)
- [`kOmegaTrans`](Transition/kOmegaTrans.qmd) - Two-equation transition and turbulence (*deprecated, model is not maintained anymore*)
- [`EARSMTrans`](Transition/EARSMTrans.qmd) - Explicit Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model with Transition (*deprecated, model is not maintained anymore*)




### LES Models
The package also provides the following LES turbulence models:

- [`XLES`](LES/XLES.qmd) - Extra Large Eddy Simulation Model due to J. C. Kok

### Boundary conditions
The package includes specialized boundary conditions for turbulence quantities, such as:

- [`omegaViscosityRatio`](BoCos/omegaViscosityRatio.qmd) - Inlet boundary condition for ω based on $\nu^t/\nu$ viscosity ratio
- [`boundedTurbulentIntensityKineticEnergyInlet`](BoCos/boundedTurbulentIntensityKineticEnergyInlet.qmd) -Inlet boundary condition for k based on turbulent intensity with lower and upper bounds
- [`ReThetatInlet`](BoCos/ReThetatInlet.qmd) - Inlet boundary condition for $Re_{\theta,t}$ for Langtry and Menter transitional model
- [`roughnessAmplification`](BoCos/roughnessAmplification.qmd) - Wall boundary condition for $A_r$ for roughness modifications in transitional models
- [`roughnessAmplificationLangel`](BoCos/roughnessAmplificationLangel.qmd) - Wall boundary condition for $A_r$ for roughness modifications in transitional models by Langel
- [`nutUKnoppWallFunction`](BoCos/nutUKnoppWallFunction.qmd) - Wall function for turbulent viscosity based on Knopp et al.
- [`omegaRoughWallFunction`](BoCos/omegaRoughWallFunction.qmd) - Wall function for ω considering surface roughness
- [`omegaWilcoxRoughWallFunction`](BoCos/omegaWilcoxRoughWallFunction.qmd) - Wall function for ω considering surface roughness due to Wilcox
